id: \rOlivia: Welcome to the Ruins of Life. Our island guardian lives around here and helps protect us.
en: \rOlivia: Welcome to the Ruins of Life. Our island guardian lives around here and helps protect us.
it: \rOlivia: Benvenuto alle Tempio della Vita. Il protettore della nostra isola vive da queste parti e ci aiuta a proteggerci.

id: \rI see you've beaten one of the trials on this island. I guess you're here to face me. Don't think I'll make this easy.
en: \rI see you've beaten one of the trials on this island. I guess you're here to face me. Don't think I'll make this easy.
it: \rVedo che hai superato una delle prove di quest'isola. Immagino tu sia qui per affrontarmi. Non pensare che te la renderò facile.

id: \rWonderful job. Take this as a reward.
en: \rWonderful job. Take this as a reward.

id: \rA Rockium Z. With that you can power up your Rock-type attacks.
en: \rA Rockium Z. With that you can power up your Rock-type attacks.
it: \rUn Petrium Z. Con questo puoi potenziare i tuoi attacchi di tipo Roccia.

id: Rotom Dex: Let's go back to Paniola Town and inform the professor of your win.
en: Rotom Dex: Let's go back to Paniola Town and inform the professor of your win.
it: Rotom Dex: Torniamo a Ohana a informare il professore della tua vittoria.

id: \rOlivia: I imagine you'll going to beat every challenge. You're already halfway there.
en: \rOlivia: I imagine you'll going to beat every challenge.  You're already halfway there.
it: \rOlivia: Immagino che supererai ogni sfida.  Sei già a metà strada.

id: \rOlivia: Kiawe and I are doing fine.
en: \rOlivia: Kiawe and I are doing fine.

id: \bKiawe: Training under Olivia has been quite an experience. I might be good enough to take you on now.
en: \bKiawe: Training under Olivia has been quite an experience. I might be good enough to take you on now.
it: \bKiawe: Allenarmi con Olivia è stata una bella esperienza. Forse ora sono abbastanza forte da affrontarti.

id: \bKiawe: Come back some other time if you're up for an intense battle.
en: \bKiawe: Come back some other time if you're up for an intense battle.
it: \bKiawe: Torna un'altra volta se te la senti di fare una lotta intensa.
